From: general-counsel@clearbranch-systems.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 1, 2026
Subject: Restrictive covenant and trade secret dispute - missing agreement and device scope

Clearbranch Systems asks for a synthetic assessment of a restrictive covenant and trade secret matter involving former employee Alex Morgan and new employer Northstar Labworks. The company is considering emergency injunction strategy and says the employment agreement, non-solicitation clause, confidentiality agreement, laptop logs, email export, device inventory, and device-forensics estimate were supposed to be attached. The received packet includes only this message. Do not assume the agreement text, device scope, forensic vendor budget, or ESI custodian list. The budget should remain blocked until policy/contract documents and ESI sources are source-bound and reviewed.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced employment agreement, non-solicitation clause, and confidentiality agreement were not included in the inbound packet.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced laptop logs, email export, and device inventory were not included in the inbound packet.
Synthetic placeholder only: referenced device-forensics estimate and forensic vendor budget were not included in the inbound packet.
